L6_text_scale.method: document.documentElement.style.fontSize set to 32px, which is how a browser's large-text setting reaches Flutter web; the engine picked the change up live, so this was measured rather than recorded as not measured
L6_text_scale.observed: the patient id wraps to two lines instead of running off the edge, the legend reflows to three lines, and the verdict keeps its icon beside the word - the three rows B12 made Flexible
L6_text_scale.honest_caveat: two labels truncate with an ellipsis at 200%: the app bar title ('Analysis re...') and the two view-toggle options ('For a pati...', 'For a clini...'). That is TextOverflow.ellipsis doing its job, not a RenderFlex overflow, and both toggle options stay visible and distinguishable, which is what view_toggle.dart's own comment aims for. It is a readability limit at 200%, not clipped-away text, and B12 did not claim to remove it.
